partner.line: There's a man who sends her medals

jester.line: You're the jester of this courtyard
jester.lineNext: With a smile like a girl's
stanza: You're the jester of this courtyard
With a smile like a girl's
Distracted by the women
With the dimples and the curls
By the pretty and the mischievous
By the timid and the blessed
By the blowing skirts of ladies
Who promise to gather you to their breast

jester.linePrev: I get a little punchy with the vodka
jester.line: Just like my great uncle Valentine Jester did
jester.lineNext: When he had to deal with those people like you
stanza: I get a little punchy with the vodka
Just like my great uncle Valentine Jester did
When he had to deal with those people like you
Who made no goddamn common sense
I'd rather walk all the way home right now
Than to spend one more second in this place
I'm exactly like you, Valentine, just
Come outside and leave with me

lester.linePrev: With some smart-ass New York Jew
lester.line: And the Jew laughed at Lester Maddox
lester.lineNext: And the audience laughed at Lester Maddox too
stanza: Last night, I saw Lester Maddox on a TV show
With some smart-ass New York Jew
And the Jew laughed at Lester Maddox
And the audience laughed at Lester Maddox too
Well, he may be a fool, but he's our fool
If they think they're better than him, they're wrong
So I went to the park and I took some paper along
And that's where I made this song
